2) Please upload either a voided check or a bank letter on company letterhead that shows account ending in 5678.
3) Confirm preferred invoice email (AP@larkware.com or invoices@larkware.com).

If you prefer, we can accept the bank letter as a secure upload link — I can send that if helpful. Once we receive those items I can mark the vendor "payment verified" and set ACH as the default remit path.
